analyst.summary: Saatvik Green Energy is a fast-growing, recently listed solar module and cell manufacturer with a large order book giving good revenue visibility. But its most recent quarter showed profit falling even as revenue grew strongly -- a margin-compression pattern showing up across several domestic solar manufacturers as new capacity floods the market. We rate it a Hold: the growth story is real, but near-term profitability needs to prove out before the very high trailing growth rates can be read as durable.
